nonblocking_findings: ADV-3 [Nit] adversarial-testing: providers.ts:39-41 and :66 leave non-HTTP SDK failures unredacted. The real SDK awaits Response.text() outside its connection-error wrapper. A body stream can reject with an Error or a string containing repeated key occurrences. Both new tests at providers.adversarial.test.ts:183-204 expose the complete key in the thrown Error. Rationale: the key exclusion rule must cover every thrown error. These fallback lines predate r4, so re-review scope makes this finding nonblocking. Green must remove the remaining key exposure. The committed failing tests still prevent the mandatory role gate from passing.
